sweetie.name: Sweetie
sweetie.description: Empathetic and sentimental. Sensitive, emotional, and in tune with the feelings of others.

cheerleader.name: Cheerleader
cheerleader.description: Positive, enthusiastic and always beaming. Smiles for their own sake and to help others smile too.

buddy.name: Buddy
buddy.description: Trustworthy and considerate. Puts their friends first and works hard to make sure everyone gets along.

daydreamer.name: Daydreamer
daydreamer.description: Idealistic and romantic. Often has their head in the clouds, but finds a lot of great ideas up there.

charmer.name: Charmer
charmer.description: Radiant and always on form. Their effortless style is admired by all. Easily adapts to new situations.

go-getter.name: Go-Getter
go-getter.description: Bold and captivating. Their wit and charm light up a room. It's never a dull moment when they're around!

merrymaker.name: Merrymaker
merrymaker.description: Outgoing and pleasant to be around. Makes friends easily, and can turn any bad situation into a good one.

dynamo.name: Dynamo
dynamo.description: Assertive and highly regarded. Trusts their own instincts, and easily commands the respect of others.

strategist.name: Strategist
strategist.description: Unique, carefree, creative, laid-back. They're self-reliant, doing things their own way and thinking outside the box.

perfectionist.name: Perfectionist
perfectionist.description: Imaginative and inspired. Happiest when creating something. Finds beauty in everyone and everything.

observer.name: Observer
observer.description: Self-sufficient and highly individual. Doesn't show much outward emotion, but has a lot going on deep down.

thinker.name: Thinker
thinker.description: Thoughtful and introspective. Great at thinking things through and analyzing issues from every angle.

achiever.name: Achiever
achiever.description: Diligent, productive, and highly efficient. Equally as skilled at planning and executing plans.

visionary.name: Visionary
visionary.description: Risk taking and ambitious. Full of energy, and acts on many whims. Once they start, they don't stop!

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Intelligent and not afraid to show it. Knowledgeable in a wide range of subjects. Answers with confidence.

maverick.name: Maverick
maverick.description: A determined self-starter. Cuts their own path, letting nothing stand in their way. Quick to execute plans.
